pages.title: Prismite Ingots
pages.text: Mine up White Sapphire and various colors of Crystal Blocks in Prismacon to make 6 of these.

pages.title: Xolite
pages.text: Mine Xolite in the Corrundum layer, then cut it at a Gem Cutting Station from Cyberland.

pages.title: Sapphire Heart
pages.text: Most Prismacon mobs can drop this, with more powerful mobs having a higher chance.

pages.title: Rubellite Heart
pages.text: Found embedded in a block in a castle, requires a Netherite Pickaxe or better to mine.

pages.title: Prismite Heart
pages.text: Craft the ingredients together, then go to a Corrundodile Arena to summon the boss.
